scope: Operation relation metadata, policy and projected vector inventory; no production or authority change.
owner: The existing Kernel operation-relation kind defines declaration/policy extensions, same-package Operation links, relation IDs, selector roots and interpreted projection operators.
changes: Read each Operation's addressed metadata members and relation IDs under their own owners.
Propagate actual roles to canonical policy and vector copies, including schedule values from interpreted instructions.
Transport nested owner names and simultaneous key swaps; do not copy the enclosing key when projecting an object value.
Validate reverse coverage against the actual relation surfaces and reject forged roles for unaddressed canonical metadata.
preserved: Source, Kernel, unrelated package/vector bytes and every actual ordered transition state remain unchanged in the public witness. The metadata extension label and capability ID rename independently; their equal original spelling is not a binding.

worker_validation.negative_scope: Six resealed candidates refuse in the reader and both authority consumers. Semantic mutations synchronize their canonical policy/vector copies first; fourteen erased/misowned occurrence cases and one forged metadata role also refuse.
worker_validation.public_scope: Actual A/B authority admission, public Model check/build, RIR import, Experiment check/run and production artifact-set validation. This does not claim independent B Runtime execution or mutual result exchange.
worker_validation.static: Both worker files pass Ruff, format and Pyright. Root CI registration passes Ruff/format.

review_correction.finding: A single pass omitted indirect Operation references when canonical equality preceded the interpreted schedule relation; reverse validation repeated the same omission. A legal equality with the interpreted value on the right also required symmetric role transport.
review_correction.decision: Adopt finite closure over existing equal-value positions. Only canonical-equal gains a reverse edge; derived schedule/policy copies stay directed. Reverse closure starts from actual relation owners and external instruction roles, excluding caller-claimed relation-surface roles.
review_correction.admission: All four original and four occurrence-renamed candidates admit through A/B. Erasing indirect references refuses reverse validation. These are authority admissions, not independent B Runtime executions.
